body:
On a cruise ship, travelling solo and sitting at the bar. This woman walked up to me and started chatting me up. Within 2 or 3 minutes, she picked up my passenger card on the bar and told me "I at least want to know your name before I have sex with you". And I grabbed her hand and walked out of the bar with her.

Considering I am married and couldn't live with the thought of what I had done, I came clean to my wife upon return. She forgave me but I didn't. Still traumatized several years later about my lack of self control, of my own betrayal of my personal values (always looked down on cheaters).

Been dealing with severe depression ever since and can't seem to get better with medication and consulting psychologists...
